comparison.pc_reference: R033 prelaunch snapshot: Windows usable RAM 15.725 GiB with 6.294 GiB available; WSL total 7796 MiB with 6924 MiB available. This was a dated snapshot and the two views are not additive.
comparison.decision: Do not transfer or launch the next physical calculation based on RAM/chip alone. The Mac has higher installed RAM and ample disk, but the inspected shell lacks the pinned FEM stack and its resource accounting has not been adapted or validated. First review the bounded physical task; if warranted, reproduce compatible dependencies, validate monitoring, compare a small reference case under unchanged tolerances, and capture both machines' launch-time capacity before any physical run.
